schools.name: Georgetown University Law Center
schools.tech_center: Institute for Technology Law & Policy; Georgetown Justice Lab; GAILP (AI & the Legal Profession Initiative)
highlights: Reported 80+ technology law courses and ~19 full-time tech-law faculty — the deepest US tech law & policy curriculum
Iron Tech Lawyer practicum (since ~2012): students build access-to-justice apps for nonprofit and court partners, capped by the global Iron Tech Lawyer Invitational
Technology Law & Policy LLM, Master of Law and Technology for non-lawyers, and Tech Law Scholars JD program
Justice Lab (founded by Tanina Rostain) plus DC-based government and tech-policy placements

schools.name: Suffolk University Law School
schools.tech_center: Legal Innovation & Technology (LIT) Lab
highlights: LIT Lab runs as a student R&D consultancy shipping production tools: Docassemble court-form automation via the Document Assembly Line, used by real courts and litigants
Nation's first JD concentration in Legal Innovation & Technology, plus an LLM (2024) and online LIT certificate; GenAI learning track delivered to all 1Ls (Hotshot partnership, 2025)
LIT Clinic and ODR Innovation Clinic (AI-powered ODR for uncontested divorce); student-built Military Benefits Assistant has served 1,300+ users
Hosts LIT Con and a student Legal AI Simulation hackathon; consistently ranked the No. 1 US legal technology program (preLaw/National Jurist)

schools.name: Singapore Management University (Yong Pung How School of Law)
schools.tech_center: Centre for Digital Law (consolidating the Centre for Computational Law and Centre for AI & Data Governance)
highlights: BSc (Computing & Law) — first of its kind in Singapore, jointly taught with the School of Computing and Information Systems
Centre for Computational Law's SGD 15M NRF programme built the open-source L4 domain-specific language for machine-executable contracts and statutes
SMU LIT hackathon — Singapore's largest inter-varsity legal tech hackathon, run in 2025 with Stanford CodeX and backed by the Ministry of Law and the Singapore Academy of Law
Partnership with the Future of Privacy Forum on digital law and data governance in APAC

schools.name: Stanford Law School
schools.tech_center: CodeX (Center for Legal Informatics); Legal Design Lab; liftlab (AI lab, 2025)
highlights: CodeX has anchored computational law for 15+ years; liftlab (2025) adds a frontier-AI build lab led by Julian Nyarko and Megan Ma
Computational Law, AI for Legal Help, and agentic-AI bootcamps; LLM in Law, Science & Technology and joint JD/MS in Computer Science
liftlab ships tools with the Mills Legal Clinic (AI voice intake for the Immigrants' Rights Clinic); Legal Design Lab co-designs AI pilots with LSC, ABA, and courts
Hosts the CodeX LLM x Law Hackathon and FutureLaw, a leading global legal tech conference; large CodeX affiliate network of legal tech companies

schools.name: University of Hong Kong — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: LITE Lab@HKU; Law and Technology Centre (joint with Computer Science since 2001, runs HKLII)
highlights: LITE Lab is explicitly experiential: credit-bearing courses (Tech Startup Law, Lawtech & Regtech Sandbox, LITE Internship) where students co-design and build lawtech tools with NGOs for access to justice
LLMs in Technology & IP Law and in Compliance & Regulation; AI law/ethics coursework
Law and Technology Centre built the 'HKU AI Lawyer' sentencing predictor; LITE Lab won a CLOC 2022 Legal Innovation award
Ecosystem ties to Cyberport, HK Science & Technology Park, and an advisory board including Ashurst, KWM, and Ant Group; Douglas Arner anchors globally prominent fintech/regtech scholarship

schools.name: Queen Mary University of London (CCLS)
schools.tech_center: Technology, Media and Telecommunications Law Institute (CCLS); qLegal
highlights: Dedicated LLM and PGCert in AI and the Law (Comparative and International AI Law, Competition and AI, Dispute Resolution and AI) alongside the long-running TMT LLM (online since 2003)
qLegal: award-winning clinic where postgraduate students advise real tech startups; externships embed students in startups one day/week for six months
Future of Law Programme: interdisciplinary law + CS teams prototype chatbots, apps, and legal design solutions (Enterprise Nation hackathon)
Faculty advise governments on AI regulation; UK's largest LLM programme

schools.name: Arizona State University (Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law)
schools.tech_center: AI and Legal Tech Studio; Center for Law, Science and Innovation (est. 1984)
highlights: AI and Legal Tech Studio: students build and deploy tools used in law firms, legal aid clinics, and courtrooms

First-in-the-nation university OpenAI partnership (ChatGPT Enterprise/Edu for law students); AI Scholars program with OpenAI, AWS, Adobe, and Meta; first US law school to allow generative AI in admissions
MLS emphasis in AI and Law, JD Certificate in Law, Science and Technology, 50+ law/science/tech courses backed by 50+ faculty fellows
AI training integrated across all degree programs; repeatedly ranked among the most innovative US law schools

schools.name: University of Ottawa Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Centre for Law, Technology and Society (Canada's largest law-and-tech hub); AI + Society Initiative
highlights: JD Option in Law and Technology (18 units, English and French) with transcript annotation; LLM concentration with Ian R. Kerr Fellowships
CIPPIC — Canada's only public-interest technology law clinic (Samuelson-Glushko endowed), doing real tech-law casework and policy interventions
Technoships place first-year students in technology law internships; Kerr Fellows get guaranteed tech-law placements
Deep faculty bench: Michael Geist, Teresa Scassa, Florian Martin-Bariteau, Marina Pavlovic — widely regarded as Canada's leading law-and-tech faculty

schools.name: Chicago-Kent College of Law (Illinois Tech)
schools.tech_center: The Law Lab (Daniel Martin Katz); Center for Access to Justice & Technology
highlights: One of the oldest formal legal-tech credentials: 18-credit JD/LLM Certificate in Legal Innovation and Technology, requiring a legal-tech externship or clinic
10+ dedicated courses: Legal Analytics, AI + Law, Programming for Lawyers, eDiscovery, Blockchain + Law, Legal Project Management (Lean Six Sigma)
Justice and Technology Practicum: students build A2J Guided Interviews for the Self-Help Web Center; C-K Law Group is one of the largest in-house clinical firms in the US
Katz's research ('GPT-4 Passes the Bar Exam') and ventures (LexPredict, 273 Ventures) tie the school directly into the legal tech industry
schools.caveats: Current activity level of the A2J Author/CAJT program in 2026 is unclear.

schools.name: UC Berkeley School of Law
schools.tech_center: Berkeley Center for Law & Technology (BCLT); Berkeley Law AI Institute
highlights: World's first LLM Certificate in AI Law and Regulation (expanded 2025), plus JD/LLM Law & Technology certificates through BCLT
One of the largest US law-and-technology curricula, with a dedicated AI area of study (Law and Governance of AI, AI Transactions and Licensing, Cybersecurity in Context)
Samuelson Law, Technology & Public Policy Clinic — a pioneering tech-policy clinic running 25+ years (algorithmic bias, deepfakes, privacy)
Top-ranked IP/tech faculty (Samuelson, Chien, Katyal, Hoofnagle, Wexler); strength skews to regulating tech rather than building it

schools.name: Maastricht University — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Maastricht Law & Tech Lab; European Centre on Privacy and Cybersecurity
highlights: Genuinely build-oriented lab: open-source legal NLP models on Hugging Face, case-law network software, and public GitHub repos ('maastrichtlawtech')
LLM Law & AI specialisation, Advanced Master in Privacy/Cybersecurity/Data Management, Bachelor Minor in Law and Technology, Legal Analytics course, and a Python Club for law students
Rethinking Justice 24-hour hackathon with students, staff, alumni, and industry
Problem-Based Learning pedagogy faculty-wide

schools.name: King's College London (Dickson Poon School of Law)
schools.tech_center: Centre for Technology, Ethics, Law and Society (TELOS)
highlights: World-first AI Literacy Programme (Jan 2026): every law student and staff member gets free access to Harvey, Legora, Luminance, and Lucio AI with structured training
King's Legal Clinic integrates legal AI (Legora) into live clinical casework — students deploy AI in real access-to-justice work
LLM pathways in Law & Technology and Digital Law (online option); AI Governance module taught by Luminance's general counsel
Freshfields sponsors a fully funded tech-focused LLM at King's for its future trainees

schools.name: Cornell Tech / Cornell Law School (NYC)
schools.tech_center: CTRL-ALT (Cornell Tech Research Lab in Applied Law and Technology); Digital Life Initiative
highlights: LLM in Law, Technology, and Entrepreneurship — first degree of its kind: a year embedded in cross-disciplinary product teams on the Roosevelt Island campus
Studio program: law students build real products alongside engineers and designers for partners like Uber and the Robin Hood Foundation
Startup Awards ($100k investments) capstone; all four 2026 winners were AI companies; legal-tech alumni startups include Kaveat
Strongest fit for lawyers who want to build or counsel startups rather than deliver legal services

schools.name: University of Melbourne — Melbourne Law School
schools.tech_center: Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Digital Ethics (CAIDE, with Engineering & IT; renewed to 2030)
highlights: Deep AI/tech-law catalogue: Artificial Intelligence and the Law, Legal AI: Design and Development (students build LLM-based legal apps), AI and Justice, International Law and AI (2026), plus undergraduate AI Ethics and the Law
Pioneering Law Apps clinic (est. 2015): JD teams built and released live Neota Logic apps for not-for-profits for a decade
Specialist Certificate and Melbourne Law Masters stream in Digital Law and Technological Innovation
Law Apps Bake Off pitch nights; hackathon with King & Wood Mallesons; CAIDE delivers AI-literacy training across Australia/NZ
schools.caveats: The flagship Law Apps clinic is listed as not offered in 2026; hands-on building has shifted to the generative-AI subject LAWS90286.

schools.name: Duke University School of Law
schools.tech_center: Duke Center on Law & Technology (DCLT); Bolch Judicial Institute
highlights: Duke Law Tech Lab — among the first law-school-run legal tech accelerators, incubating justice-tech startups
Hands-on AI coursework: Practicing Law with AI and Big Data, AI Law and Policy, Frontier AI & Robotics; RAILS initiative on responsible AI in legal services
LLM in Law and Entrepreneurship plus Start-Up Ventures Clinic — a distinctive entrepreneurship-plus-justice-tech track
Top-tier experiential program overall (clinics, externships, startup immersion)

schools.name: Northwestern Pritzker School of Law
schools.tech_center: Law and Technology Initiative (joint with McCormick Engineering); Innovation Lab
highlights: Innovation Lab co-taught by Dan Linna (law) and Kris Hammond (CS): mixed law/CS teams build prototypes for firms, legal departments, legal aid orgs, and courts
AI and Legal Reasoning course (Bloomberg innovation finalist); hosted the first AI for Law Scholars Conference (2025)
Master of Science in Law (MSL) scales tech-adjacent legal education to non-lawyers; JD concentration in Technology, Innovation, and Entrepreneurship
The institutional law-engineering bridge (joint appointments with McCormick) is unique among US peers

schools.name: Swansea University (Hillary Rodham Clinton School of Law)
schools.tech_center: Legal Innovation Lab Wales (£5.6m facility with an in-house software team and legal AI laboratory)

A funded lab with actual software developers on staff, building tools for legal businesses, access to justice, and security platforms
Law Clinic connected to the lab, so LegalTech tools are developed and applied in clinic work
Open collaboration model with law firms, technology companies, and security organisations

schools.name: University of Technology Sydney (UTS) — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Hosts AustLII (Australasian Legal Information Institute), a major legal-informatics institution
highlights: Legal Futures and Technology major in the LLB — an Australian first — with an applied tech project capstone and legal-tech internships (LawPath, AustLII, Westpac, Marrickville Legal Centre)
Allens Neota UTS Law Tech Challenge for Social Justice, running since 2016: student teams build AI-driven apps for non-profits with Allens mentoring
Bachelor of IT / Bachelor of Laws dual degree; first Sydney university to offer Practical Legal Training in-house
Disruptive Technologies and the Law elective covers AI in practice, e-discovery, and emerging-tech regulation

schools.name: Vanderbilt Law School
schools.tech_center: Vanderbilt AI Law Lab (VAILL); Program on Law & Innovation (PoLI)
highlights: VAILL (Nov 2023, co-directed by Cat Moon and Mark Williams) was among the first dedicated law school AI labs; students build and test AI-driven access-to-justice tools
Human-centered design curriculum: Legal Problem Solving, Law Practice 2050, hands-on AI tool workshops
Inaugural VAILL hackathon (2025) on AI and the civil justice gap; recurring Music City Legal Hackers events; collaboration with Suffolk's LIT Lab
Culturally one of the most AI-forward US law schools, with outsized public programming relative to size

schools.name: IE University — IE Law School
schools.tech_center: LawAhead Center; Lawtomation Centre (Jean Monnet Centre of Excellence); IE Legaltech Innovation Farm
highlights: Master in Legaltech (ML, legalbots, blockchain, cybersecurity, big data) plus an AI-Powered Legal Practice program covering the EU AI Act and AI governance
Legaltech Innovation Farm — Spain's first legaltech open-innovation ecosystem, co-developing solutions with Santander, A&O, Baker McKenzie, Deloitte, Linklaters, IBM, and Microsoft
Runs the Global LegalTech Venture Days international startup competition with the Law Schools Global League
AI embedded across curricula 'from Digital Law to AI-Powered Legal Practice'

schools.name: Harvard Law School
schools.tech_center: Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society; Library Innovation Lab; Access to Justice Lab
highlights: 2025-26 catalog is AI-dense: CS50 (and AI) for Lawyers, AI and the Future of Law, Law and Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI and the Law, International AI Law and Governance
Cyberlaw Clinic (Berkman Klein) does live tech-and-access-to-justice work including a Massachusetts Trial Court technology project
Library Innovation Lab builds open legal-data infrastructure (Perma.cc, Caselaw Access Project lineage); Access to Justice Lab runs RCTs on legal interventions
World-leading AI governance scholarship (Jonathan Zittrain et al.), though orientation is more policy/research than student tool-building; no legal-tech degree or concentration

schools.name: Bucerius Law School
schools.tech_center: Center for Legal Technology and Data Science (academic director: Daniel Martin Katz)
highlights: Flagship 3-week summer program 'AI, Legal Technology and Operations' with a hackathon capstone — instructors drawn from industry, Stanford CodeX, and the Legal Design Lab
Legal Technology and Operations specialization in the Master of Law and Business; Technology Certificate within the LLB
Legal Data Science Research Group and BMBF-funded NLP research (HILANO); publishes legal tech market and legal-ops reports with industry

schools.name: National University of Singapore — Faculty of Law

LLM specialisation and graduate certificates in IP & Technology Law

schools.name: University of Toronto Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Future of Law Lab; Centre for Innovation Law and Policy
highlights: Multiple 2025-26 AI courses: Contemporary Issues in AI Regulation, Law and Ethics of AI, AI and the Rule of Law, AI Policy/Ethics/Governance (GPLLM)
GPLLM concentration in Innovation, Law and Technology for working professionals
Future of Law Lab runs hackathons (90+ participants), case simulations, and research projects
Strongest computational-law commercialization pipeline in Canada: Blue J (Benjamin Alarie/Anthony Niblett) spun out of the faculty; ties to the Vector Institute

schools.name: University of Edinburgh — Edinburgh Law School
schools.tech_center: SCRIPT Centre (Scottish Research Centre for IP and Technology Law)
highlights: One of Europe's deepest and most technical tech-law catalogues: Robotics AI and the Law, Software and the Law, Hardware and the Law, Decentralised Technologies, Cybercrime and Cyber Security
LLM in Innovation, Technology and the Law (on-campus and online) plus an online LLM in IT Law
Law and AI Hackathon where student teams build tech solutions; Summer School in Legal Technology with international practitioners
Burkhard Schafer's computational legal theory group is among the longest-established in Europe

schools.name: Tsinghua University School of Law

Applied research on big data and AI in China's smart-court/judicial informatization agenda

schools.name: Toronto Metropolitan University (Lincoln Alexander School of Law)

schools.name: Flinders University — College of Business, Government and Law
schools.tech_center: Flinders Digital Law Lab
highlights: Australia's first compulsory app-building law topic: every LLB student takes Law in a Digital Age, where law + CS teams build real legal apps and chatbots (Docassemble, Neota Logic) for access-to-justice clients — 60+ apps built

LLB (Honours) Legal Practice Entry satisfies academic admission requirements Australia-wide; semester-long industry placements

schools.name: Swinburne University of Technology — Swinburne Law School
schools.tech_center: Legal Tech Clinic and Legal Design Clinic (Dr Mitchell Adams)
highlights: Legal Tech Clinic builds solutions for real law firm clients (e.g., 2025 warranty-claim triage prototype for CIE Legal)

Flagship Legal Technology and Innovation unit covers computational legal thinking, generative AI, and human-centred legal design with hands-on building
LLB / Computer Science double degree (AI options); concurrent PLT via Leo Cussen accelerates admission

schools.name: KU Leuven — Faculty of Law and Criminology
schools.tech_center: CiTiP — Centre for IT & IP Law (80+ researchers; imec research group)

Unmatched engineering integration via imec, LICT, COSIC, and DistriNet; annual Leuven IP and AI Conference

schools.name: UNSW Sydney — Faculty of Law & Justice
highlights: Designing Technology Solutions for Access to Justice: project-based course where student teams build legal apps for not-for-profits (Gilbert + Tobin / Neota Logic supported)
2026 handbook AI courses: Artificial Intelligence: Law and Governance; Big Tech, AI and the Law; comparative law-and-tech course with University of Zurich

schools.name: Michigan State University College of Law
schools.tech_center: Center for Law, Technology & Innovation (LegalRnD Lab; Innovation Hub)

Practice-ready curriculum across four focus areas including New Technologies and Law and Law Practice Technology
Kennedy's industry network (former Mastercard VP/deputy GC; 2024 American Legal Technology Lifetime Achievement) anchors employer ties

schools.name: Osgoode Hall Law School (York University)
schools.tech_center: Winkler Institute for Dispute Resolution; OsgoodePD
highlights: Deliberately expanded JD tech curriculum: A.I. and Technology in Legal Practice, Legal Values: Artificial Intelligence, Engineering the Law, plus hands-on professional skills micro-courses
OsgoodePD leads Canadian professional education in AI/privacy/cybersecurity (Professional LLM in Privacy and Cybersecurity Law; AI and the Law short courses)
One of Canada's largest experiential programs (Parkdale Community Legal Services, clinical intensives); co-organized the HackJustice hackathon

schools.name: Tel Aviv University — Buchmann Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Shamgar Center for Digital Law and Innovation (2022); Algorithmic Governance Lab
highlights: Law & Technology specialization in the Parasol Foundation International LLM (14-15 of 32 credits in tech-law courses)
Israel's first Privacy Clinic (with the Shamgar Center since 2022)
Top-tier faculty: Niva Elkin-Koren (AI governance, platform regulation), Michael Birnhack (privacy/data protection); dedicated 2025 journal volume on AI
Algorithmic Governance Lab cooperates with government and industry

schools.name: Tilburg University — Tilburg Law School
schools.tech_center: Tilburg Institute for Law, Technology, and Society (TILT)
highlights: TILT is one of Europe's top law-and-technology research institutes; edits the journal Technology and Regulation and hosts TILTing Perspectives
LLM Law and Technology (English, two intakes/year, on-campus or fully online) spanning AI governance, privacy, cybercrime, fintech, and platform regulation
Lawyers from international firms are systematically involved in LLM teaching

schools.name: O.P. Jindal Global University (Jindal Global Law School)
schools.tech_center: Cyril Shroff Centre for AI, Law & Regulation (India's first dedicated AI-law centre, ₹15 crore endowment); JIRICO

Cyril Shroff Centre plans partnerships with NITI Aayog, MeitY, RBI, SEBI, TRAI, and global bodies (OECD, US FTC, UK AISI)
Annual Jindal Technology Law and Policy International Moot; Qualcomm-funded IP-competition research via JIRICO

schools.name: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
schools.tech_center: JSW Centre for the Future of Law (2024)

L-Tech (est. 1995) is India's oldest student tech-law society; LLM concentration covers comparative AI regulation including the EU AI Act

schools.name: University of Copenhagen — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Copenhagen Legal/Tech Lab; Centre for Information and Innovation Law (CIIR)
highlights: Hands-on courses: Legal Tech Laboratory (working with deployed European legal-tech tools), DigiLawyer, How to Start a Start-up (with real Copenhagen startups)
Campus Legal/Tech Hackathons ('Decentralising Finance' 2022, 'AI for a Sustainable Future' 2023) with industry mentors
Lab maps the Danish legal-tech ecosystem (Legal Tech Map & Report 2024); CIIR researches generative AI and IP

schools.name: University of Oxford, Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Deep Tech Dispute Resolution Lab; university Institute for Ethics in AI (joint Law/AI-regulation post)
highlights: Law and Computer Science option (BCL/MJur) co-taught with the CS department: mixed law/CS teams design and implement a digital legal service as a group project

Deep Tech Dispute Resolution Lab prototypes ODR/smart-contract tech with legal designers and engineers
Extensive AI-and-law research around the Institute for Ethics in AI

schools.name: Chinese University of Hong Kong — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Centre for Legal Innovation and Digital Society (CLINDS)
highlights: New dedicated LLM in AI Law launching in the 2026-27 academic year
Legal Technologies courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate level; offerings on ODR, AI and IP, and smart contracts
Active research cluster (Jyh-An Lee on IP/AI/platforms) with annual AI governance conferences

schools.name: Hebrew University of Jerusalem — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Federmann Cyber Security Research Center — Cyber Law Program (joint with the Benin School of Computer Science)
highlights: Deep cyber/tech course cluster: Cyber Law, Israeli and International Cybersecurity Law, Cyber Crimes, Internet Governance, plus cross-listed CS courses
Year-long Clinic on Digital Rights and Human Rights in Cyberspace within one of Israel's leading clinical programs
Federmann Center scholarship spans cyber operations law, cybercrime, and AI governance, with government (INCD) ties

schools.name: Reichman University — Harry Radzyner Law School
schools.tech_center: Zvi Meitar Institute for Legal Implications of Emerging Technologies
highlights: MA/LLM in Law, Technology and Business Innovation (200+ students, running since ~2020)
Selective cross-disciplinary Zvi Meitar Emerging Technologies Program spanning Law, Business, CS, and Government schools
Institute policy work on responsible AI regulation; strong university-wide entrepreneurship culture

schools.name: University of St. Gallen (HSG) — Law School
schools.tech_center: Law & Tech Lab @ HSG (six-professor research cluster)
highlights: Optional Law and Technology specialization within the MLaw, Master in Law and Economics, and Master in International Law
Active faculty output on AI liability, algorithmic decision-making, robotics, and platform regulation (Wildhaber, Simmler, Buiten, Tamò-Larrieux)
First 'Hack the Law' legal hackathon scheduled November 2026; Swiss LegalTech Association student chapter bridges to industry
HSG's integrative law-plus-management model

schools.name: University College London (UCL), Faculty of Laws
schools.tech_center: Institute of Brand and Innovation Law; Information Technology Law Collective
highlights: New LLM Law and Technology specialism (2026-27): AI and algorithmic decision-making, data governance, platform regulation, fintech, digital-markets competition
AI and Law summer school and 'AI for Lawyers' executive course for practitioners
Research community that shapes courts, regulators, and governments on digital technology law
schools.caveats: Taught academic pathway — no clinic where students build or deploy legal tech.

schools.name: University of Cambridge, Faculty of Law
highlights: LLM paper 'Law, Technology and Society' explicitly covers AI and machine learning, alongside strong IP/information-law papers via CIPIL
Cambridge hosts Hack_the_Law / LLM x Law Hackathon (King's Entrepreneurship Lab): 2025 edition drew students from 43 universities, with winners fast-tracked into the SPARK incubator

schools.name: University of Geneva — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Digital Law Center (2020)
highlights: Certificat en droit du numérique (from 2025) with a mandatory Digital and AI Law course and workshop, capped at 25 students
Annual Digital Law Summer School (AI, cybersecurity, big data, platform law) with an embedded clinic experience
Collaborations with Berkman Klein, ITU, WIPO, and Geneva's international-organization ecosystem

schools.name: University of Auckland — Auckland Law School
schools.tech_center: Centre for Advancing Law and Technology Responsibly (ALTeR, with Business & Economics)

Named AI electives: Law and Artificial Intelligence; Technology Law and Policy
ALTeR legal tech hackathon (2025): interdisciplinary teams prototyped an AI legal assistant for access to justice

schools.name: Peking University Law School
schools.tech_center: PKU Legal AI Laboratory (2017, with Gridsum); Digital Rule of Law Research Center
highlights: Early mover: Legal AI Lab founded in 2017 for AI product R&D in legal applications
Courses in Law and Artificial Intelligence, Topics in Digital Law, and Data Regulation and Compliance
Active digital-law scholarship and conferences on AI and legal theory

schools.name: University of Helsinki — Faculty of Law
schools.tech_center: Legal Tech Lab (director Riikka Koulu, professor of Social and Legal Implications of AI)
highlights: Nordic pioneer: organized Finland's first legal hackathon (2017) and hosts the Legal Tech Con conference
Strong critical/academic scholarship on algorithmic decision-making and AI in judicial processes
